title: Visitor audit
desc: Access to all sites summarized by visitor address: who visited which sites and paths, when, under which identity, and how often they were blocked. Only aggregated counts are kept here; see the access log for individual requests.
paused: Visitor audit is disabled. New visits are no longer recorded; existing data can still be viewed.
saveError: Failed to write data to disk: {error}
search: Search IP, user, site, path or UA
empty: No visitors in this range yet
storage: Kept {days} days · {count} / {max} visitors recorded · data file {size}
storageHelp: Written to disk about 10 minutes after changes, and immediately on exit
deleteConfirm: Delete this visitor's audit record? The ban status stays as it is.
pathsHelp: Up to 10 paths are kept per visitor, path only; individual requests are in the access log (the site needs access logging enabled).
banDesc: After banning {ip}, its requests to all web sites are rejected.
banIpv6: IPv6 addresses are banned by their /64 prefix.
enableHelp: When disabled, new visits are no longer recorded and existing data is kept.
daysHelp: Visitors whose last visit is older than this are deleted, and daily counts are kept for this many days (1-180); shortening it deletes the excess data immediately.
maxHelp: When exceeded, addresses that were only blocked or only hit unmatched sites are evicted first, then those not seen for the longest time (100-100000).
clearConfirm: Clear the audit records of all {n} visitors? This cannot be undone.
privacyHelp: Data is stored only in visitors/ under the local config directory and is left out of config backups. Addresses, sites, paths, identities and User-Agents are recorded; query strings, request bodies, cookies and credentials are always left out.
shrinkConfirm: After shortening the retention, visitors last seen more than {days} days ago and older daily counts are deleted immediately and cannot be recovered. Save anyway?
